title: Beef Bourguignon
ingredients: 250g (9oz) chestnut mushrooms, halved or quartered if large
method: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan (400°F), Gas Mark 6.

Spray a large flameproof casserole dish (with a lid) with oil and stir-fry the celery, bacon and shallots over a medium heat for 3 minutes. Add the beef and garlic and stir-fry for a further 5 minutes to sear the outside of the beef.

Stir the cornflour through, then add the wine, hot stock, tomato purée, thyme, rosemary, salt and pepper, soy sauce, carrots and mushrooms. Gently mix and bring to a simmer. Place the lid on the pan and put on to the middle shelf of the oven for 1 hour.
After 1 hour, give everything a stir, add the baby potatoes, replace the lid and cook for a further 1 hour.
notes: A leaner version of the French classic. Potatoes are added to make it a meal-in-one. Crusty French bread to mop up the sauce is highly recommended.
